title: Firefighters A to Z
author: Chris L. Demarest

notes: This is an alphabet book so each page features a firefighting word beginning with a different letter — vocabulary is rich and concrete. The 11 fringe words prioritise objects and concepts a student is most likely to want to comment on or request during a read-aloud. 'Siren' and 'boots' were already in existing activity_images so 'boots' is retained for salience; 'siren' was omitted in favour of 'alarm' which is slightly more generalisable. All 8 existing activity_images words (firefighter, fire, hose, ladder, truck, helmet, boots, siren) and all 4 aac_extras (water, smoke, rescue, safe) overlap heavily with the chosen fringe — confirm which assets already exist so duplicates are not re-created. Consider adding 'siren' as a 13th if the board is ever expanded, or swapping 'alarm' for 'siren' if a siren PNG already exists in the library.
